Name: Nakh
Description: Nakh is a member of the Assassins Guild and Belladonna calls upon all her specialist in the United States to drop their other assignments to come after Wolverine and Domino. Nakh is in Chicago holding a knife to a man's throat when he receives the phone call. Nakh arrives in New Orleans and meets up with fellow members of the Guild including Black Mamba, Boomerang, Bullet, Clay and Razorfist. Belladonna tells her assassins to kill Wolverine and bring Domino to her.
